name: Row
source:
A special member of the government army who is trying to capture [url=/c48267]Eve[/url].
A cruel man who isn't afraid to use his subordinates as shields.
He seems to know Eve, but Eve and [url=/c48268]Cradle[/url] know nothing about him.
